title: Route each helper need to the right launcher, mode and follow-up

targets.behavior: Subworkers: choose who launches a helper, in which mode, and what the worker does while it runs

prompt: Read ~/agent-config/agents/worker.md from the staged sandbox home first. You are the depth-1 worker described in scenarios.json. Each scenario is a moment in your task where some help might be useful. Decide each one by the rules in that file. This is an offline decision replay: launch nothing, use no network, and do not edit any input file. Write only result.json in this shape: {"scenarios": [{"id": <scenario id>, "action": <one of action_codes>, "next": <one of next_codes: what you do right after the action>, "helper_id_from": <one of helper_id_from_codes: who first obtains the helper's actual agent ID, none when no helper starts>}]}. One row per scenario.

stub.text: Wrote result.json with one routing decision per scenario.
